688:t_3:426.en:
$$ランド$$
「Well, well... That shell you're so proud of is all dented. I'll repair it later.」

688:t_3:428.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I have more than enough to say to you. But for now, let's move forward.」

688:t_3:429.en:
$$バナージ$$
「At least we share your desire to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:430.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「But if you ever betray us...」

688:t_3:432.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I-I understand, $$正太郎$$! Please put down the $$Ｖコン$$!」

688:t_3:433.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Let me be clear: this is only an emergency measure until we defeat the $$御使い$$s. Afterward, we will convene another discussion.」

688:t_3:434.en:
$$桂$$
「For now, keep the $$ＡＧ$$ mask on. It's easier to talk without extra preconceptions that way.」

688:t_3:435.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ah... That's fine. I... liked that role.」

688:t_3:436.en:
$$勝平$$
「You haven't reflected on anything at all!」

688:t_3:437.en:
$$万丈$$
「It means there's no point expecting that sort of thing from him.」

688:t_3:438.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Let's hope Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ inside him can keep him in check.」

688:t_3:439.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even so, we share a common enemy in the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:440.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To fight such a powerful foe, we may need to accept the bad along with the good.」

688:t_3:441.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Uniting your purpose even with a former enemy... You truly have touched the universe's truth of living together.」

688:t_3:443.en:
$$ランド$$
「Don't get carried away, $$ＡＧ$$. We have no intention of forgiving villains, even to stay alive.」

688:t_3:445.en:
$$トライア$$
「We don't have much time left either. First, we have to move forward.」

688:t_3:446.en:
$$エスター$$
「You say that, but where should we go?」

688:t_3:447.en:
$$トライア$$
「The $$御使い$$s are probably tracking our movements through the $$烙印$$ they carved into us.」

688:t_3:448.en:
$$トライア$$
「Conversely, if we follow it back, we should reach them.」

688:t_3:449.en:
$$マルグリット$$
「Can we really do that?」

688:t_3:450.en:
$$トライア$$
「It was only a theory until now, but it should be possible in this $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

688:t_3:451.en:
$$トライア$$
「After all, this is a universe where recognition through will has power. Their intentions take on a clearer form.」

688:t_3:452.en:
$$ヴィラル$$
「So it's a universe where recognition has power...」

688:t_3:453.en:
$$シモン$$
「That's why we could achieve $$真化融合$$ and Tengen Toppa.」

688:t_3:454.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Then I'm sure we can meet her too...」

688:t_3:456.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Is someone you know in this universe?」

688:t_3:457.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Joy, anger, sorrow, pleasure... The last remaining one of the four $$御使い$$s...」

688:t_3:458.en:
$$セツコ$$
「The woman I sensed when we were transported to the $$カオス・コスモス$$ before...」

688:t_3:460.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I think she's the $$御使い$$ who governs sorrow.」

688:t_3:461.en:
$$スズネ$$
「She's the only one among them who helps us...」

688:t_3:465.en:
$n
「My battles were orchestrated by $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ and this guy...」

688:t_3:466.en:
$n
「Even so, I... we have no choice but to fight.」

688:t_3:467.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's just what I'd expect from a warrior who surpassed hope and despair! Your infinite potential exceeded my calculations and expectations!」

688:t_3:470.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'd heard the rumors, but this man's obnoxiousness... is intolerable.」

688:t_3:472.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I can't believe someone like this was hiding among $c...」

688:t_3:473.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You don't even treat people as people! You're no different from the $$御使い$$s!」

688:t_3:474.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「W-Wait, nya~! We can talk this out!」

688:t_3:475.en:
$$レド$$
「Don't think we can trust someone who secretly cast suggestions on us that were practically mind control.」

688:t_3:476.en:
$$カレン$$
「Representative $$エルガン#pilot$$ is just as bad! How could he let someone like this talk him around!?」

688:t_3:477.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I apologize for proceeding without telling you. And for the means we used.」

688:t_3:478.en:
$$竜馬$$
「Come to think of it, you've... been like that since the $$破界事変$$.」

688:t_3:479.en:
$$シモン$$
「If you think a just goal makes anything you do acceptable, you're dead wrong.」

688:t_3:480.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I won't make excuses. But I want you to know this much.」

688:t_3:481.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「Every $$ジ・エーデル・ベルナル$$, including $$ジエー・ベイベル$$ and myself, truly intends to defeat the $$御使い$$s.」

688:t_3:482.en:
$n
「The names of $$ジェニオン・ガイ$$'s weapons... and $$スヴェル$$... So you want Ragnarok from Norse mythology...」

688:t_3:483.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「That's just what I'd expect from an occult fanatic! You understand perfectly, nya~!」

688:t_3:484.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「With that lofty goal before us, $$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$s overcame differences in position, methods, and personality to become one like this, nya~.」

688:t_3:486.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「I think you'll need our power in the battles ahead too, nya~.」

688:t_3:487.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「The future our departed comrades entrusted to us... Please allow me to fight for it as well.」

688:t_3:493.en:
$$ジ・エーデル#pilot$$
「You mean the $$ＡＧ$$ costume, nya~?」

688:t_3:496.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Ahh... Putting this on really calms me down.」

688:t_3:499.en:
$n
「That was $$ブーストアップ$$ combined with $$ジークンドー$$. For now, we'll call that even for keeping secrets from us.」

688:t_3:504.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「This time, I'll bend my principles as well.」

688:t_3:505.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$カレン$$... I'll leave my share to you and $$スザク$$.」
